value.rationale: Boundary escape at fixed hyperbolic area is a natural concentration/uncertainty question in analytic wavelet localization. The theorem provides a full nontrivial spectral phase diagram: a thin regime in which the norm vanishes despite fixed trace but all Schatten powers have sharp constants, and a finite-width regime with a nonzero gamma-window limiting norm; it identifies the optimizing degree and exact degeneracy locus. These quantities are useful beyond routine pointwise beta-prime densities, and the q-dependent hierarchy quantifies effective concentration and spectral spread.
